preconditions.description: Number of points is between 1 and 100.
Number of segments is between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= xi <= 100 for xi in x)
preconditions.description: Each point coordinate is between 0 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= li <= ri <= 100 for li, ri in segments)
preconditions.description: Each segment's left boundary is less than or equal to its right boundary, and both are between 0 and 100.

postconditions.description: The output is either '-1' indicating no good drawing, or a list of n integers representing the colors of the points.

postconditions.expression: all(color in {0, 1} for color in return_value)
postconditions.description: Each color in the output is either 0 (red) or 1 (blue).

postconditions.expression: all(abs(sum(1 for xi in x if li <= xi <= ri and return_value[i] == 0) - sum(1 for xi in x if li <= xi <= ri and return_value[i] == 1)) <= 1 for i, (li, ri) in enumerate(segments))
postconditions.description: For each segment, the absolute difference between the number of red and blue points within the segment is at most 1.
